question: Can a universal maximum G larger than locally measured G, combined with bounded path-dependent recovery of gravity vectors, fit galaxies, BCGs, cluster lensing, and raw image positions?

root_model.field: g(r)=G_max M_b(<r) C(r)/r^2 with G_measured=C_solar G_max
root_model.bounded_completion: logit C(r)=logit C_solar+tau(r), so C_solar <= C(r) < 1
root_model.path_memory: tau(r) is a nonnegative recovery optical depth accumulated from the source center to r
root_model.effective_exponent: p_eff=-d ln g/d ln r; outside baryons p_eff=2-d ln C/d ln r
root_model.flat_curve_condition: d ln C/d ln r approximately 1 gives g proportional to 1/r
root_model.maximum_coupling: G_max/G_measured=1/C_solar; values greater than one are explicitly allowed

matter_path.interpretation: g_bar is a spherical surface-density proxy for matter encountered by the path

sample.bridge: 44 MaNGA BCG points plus 72 density-resolved CLASH radial points
sample.bridge_objective: equal-domain mean of equal-system mean squared log residual
sample.SPARC: 131 galaxies; nuisance parameters fit on 2066 inner points and tested on 968 untouched outer points
sample.raw_lensing: RX J2129 15 training and 7 already-spent heldout image positions
sample.cluster_target_warning: CLASH acceleration targets were deprojected from fitted NFW lensing profiles

selection.bridge_ranking: lowest five-fold heldout bridge equal-domain RMSE
selection.downstream_rule: run every predefined model on SPARC and raw lensing; a survivor must pass every frozen gate

claim_limits: This is a spherical weak-field transport prototype, not a covariant action.
The BCG sample has one radial point per system, so its unobserved inner path is approximated by the declared center boundary.
SPARC disks and irregular clusters are not actually spherical; g_bar/r and radial path length are proxies.
The maximum-G interpretation is observationally equivalent to a bounded environment-dependent effective coupling until independently tested.
RX J2129 coordinates are an already-inspected diagnostic, not an independent holdout.
